title: re-announce loop lacks error containment: exception escapes to generic receive-loop handler
description: Robustness review of 99sg.2 (pass 3, finding 1): node.py _reannounce_capabilities_to_new_root has no try/except around the build/sign/encode/send loop body. If anything raises (aiocoap drift on the private _mtype/_mid kwargs, unexpected link-layer error), the exception escapes _process_received into the generic except in the receive loop, logged without re-announce attribution, and any unprocessed entries in the already-drained batch are silently lost. A targeted try/except Exception around the loop body, logging and continuing, matches the fire-and-forget intent.
close_reason: FIXED on beads-worker-4: the capability re-announce build/sign/encode/send is wrapped in try/except Exception logging 'capability re-announce to new root %s failed' — failures no longer escape into the receive loop as opaque tracebacks. Drain still precedes the try (fire-and-forget), CancelledError/BaseException still propagates; seq/MID gaps on failure are harmless (replay floor is monotonic). Test test_send_exception_is_contained_and_logged pins containment + drain. 10/10 tests pass; ruff/mypy clean. 3x codereview (kimi): correctness PASS, security PASS, robustness PASS.
